name: Doki Doki! New Eyes
source:
"At first, I only thought it would be temporary.
However, soon, things started getting weirder and weirder. Whenever he was around, my heart would beat faster, and I wouldn’t control my body anymore. There’s nothing wrong with that… Right?"

What you see isn't necessarily what's real. Sometimes, you need to change your perspective a little... You need to look at the world with new eyes.

[From [url=https://www.cykadev.com/neweyes/]CykaDev Website[/url]]
translation:
“起初，我以为这只是暂时的。
然而，事情很快变得越来越奇怪。他在身边时，我的心跳会加速，身体也不再受自己控制。这样没什么问题……对吧？”

你所看到的未必就是真实。有时，你需要稍微改变视角……用全新的目光审视这个世界。

（来源：[url=https://www.cykadev.com/neweyes/]CykaDev网站[/url]）
